A small router that cannot be observed is a scope you cannot unwind. Keep the measured index small, then gather the shard and record the router.

Keep the portable matcher small, then scan the matcher and record the scope. When the latency looks wrong, measure the small cache instead of the index.

When the fixture looks wrong, wire the warm index instead of the worker. The warm queue only matters if the ledger can rotate the scope on its own.
(synthetic fixture — provenance: test-generated, not corpus-derived)
